in_marathi.name: Sukrit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukrit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sukrit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sukrut' which means 'auspicious', 'meritorious', or 'well-done'. This name is often given to a child who is born under auspicious circumstances or is expected to bring good fortune to the family. Sukrit is a rare and meaningful name that signifies prosperity, success, and good fortune.
